prose: Mike Winner is the host of the legendary Alfa Cast along with Dr. Barre Lando. From the remote shores of the Smith River in the rural Pacific Northwest, Mike and Barre are cultivating a biodynamic ecosystem, creating online events and offline gatherings, bringing together the knowledge to build a better society, and the right people to utilize it.
ext: We discuss the Music & Sky Festival, 90's rave culture, the spiritual analogue to technological advancements, cannabis lessons, crypto and the Qortal Project, privacy & sovereignty, and a lot more.
